pi_comparison.scope: Same Linux ARM64 container, Verilator/GCC and official single-thread build. Both baseline and candidate pi are timed within their full official suites; baseline is the preceding accepted early-multiply/division-reuse version. This is not a measurement on the OJ host.

scope: Only muldiv_unit.sv changed relative to the preceding accepted MDU-speed version. Full official 19-case correctness and 6-case performance, 189 strict default runs, 945 compatibility runs, 27 architectural/bus fault runs, 12 writeback fault runs, 2 combinational-loop checks, Icarus/Verilator MDU units, four local arithmetic proofs and full-chip synthesis/STA use the same frozen RTL. Unchanged memory, frontend units and unrelated formal proofs were not rerun. Timing is the unchanged course ideal-clock/no-parasitics estimate. Runtime is local Linux ARM64, not the OJ host.

documentation_versioning.note: Release labels and document references were normalized. Measurements, commands, source hashes and original build artifact paths are unchanged.
